entityDescription:
Dhow Energy is a independent consultancy company currently recognised as a Incubation Candidate by ESRIC, LIST, LSA. Dhow Energy has the intention to grow into a Limited Liability Company to grow its services, products, software solutions and the team.
Dhow Energy is focussed on Natural Resources Exploration for the markets of tomorrow, i.e. affordable, accessible and sustainable resources. The founder and associates build their expertise on strong industrial skills and competenties from the oil and gas sector for resource prospecting, technologies, portfolio management, geological mapping, petrophysics, geophysics, field work and business management & strategies.

Dhow Energy aims to assist in explorational activities in search for natural resource that are valuable for national and international energy strategy targets. Dhow Energy project focus adheres to the Sustainable DevelopmentGoal #7: "Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energyfor all."The company's primary activities are related to geoscientific resource evaluations and business feasibility studies in the form of independent consultancy. It's ambition is to grow its project portfolio and develop relatedproducts and I.P.It's expertise is focused on subsurface evaluation studies of: oil & gas fordevelopment, geothermal, lithium, and natural hydrogen. Dhow Energy aims to deliver neutral and independent project and technicalevaluations and advice based on science and geostatistical evaluations.

Through incubation under the European Space Resource Innovation Center, ESRIC, in Luxembourg, Dhow Energy aims to cooperate through partnerships and business solutions, on the topic of Lunar Resource Prospecting and prospecting de-risking strategies. This includes data analyses, complex data-integration, geological interpretation and concept building, and risk and volume assessment for resource presence following the resource classification system.

Dhow Energy aspires to have a positive impact on the Space Resource Prospecting sector by bridging < science and tech > with < investors , managers and mission decision makers >.

description:
Vexiza is a company specialized in GIS technology, Cloud, Big Data, and Artificial Intelligence that creates customized solutions that enable organizations to leverage the potential of location-based data.
Our goal is to help companies working daily with complex and massive amounts of data to improve their decision-making and business operations through the use of geospatial intelligence. But to achieve this, we do much more than maps. GIS technology allows us to unleash the creativity within our cross-disciplinary team of industry experts in engineering, geospatial technology, and software development.
Our UX-centered approach enables our customers to rely on powerful yet user-friendly platforms, regardless of the professional industry they work in. This includes areas such as emergency management, the environment, or traffic, among many others.
This way, we have met the challenge of converting data from complex phenomena, such as meteorology or wildfires, into actionable insights that are easy to put into action in any scenario, even when quick reactions based on reliable information are needed.

entityName: LD - Lisbon Dynamics Advanced Computing Technologies, Lda
entityDescription:
Lisbon Dynamics is a start-up company specialised in Machine Learning and Computer Vision, whose mission is to develop innovative projects, possibly of high complexity, using advanced programming techniques and integrating different areas of engineering.

We are particularly comfortable with reconstructing large-scale three-dimensional models (hundreds of km2) using photogrammetry or LiDAR.

Given the significant amount of information generated, our solution allows the resulting model to be visualised in a fluid and interactive way, with millimetre precision if necessary.

Our first product RockVision.AI aims to analyse on a large scale the risk of falling blocks detached from the massif on a mountain surface.

Recently, in order to test our models on a larger scale, we completed in just 3 days the 3D modelling project of an entire municipality: 460 km2 with 10 cm accuracy, which generated approximately 4Tb of information.

entityName: Vasco da Gama CoLAB - Energy Storage - Associação
entityDescription:
Vasco da Gama CoLAB (VG CoLAB) is a collaborative laboratory, supported by the Portuguese Agencies for Science and Technology (FCT) and Innovation (ANI). VG CoLAB was established in 2019 in Porto as a non-profit private association, and the associates include public and private partners from academia and industry. VG CoLAB is an associate member of IPCEI EuBatIn and BEPA.
VG CoLAB develops innovative system-oriented technological solutions applying energy storage to enable the energy transition. Fuelled by industrial and services sectors, it delivers mid-TRL prototypes and business support services scaling up relevant and novel scientific research findings.
​It is positioned in the centre of the electrochemical energy storage value chain, developing innovation activities, such as prototypes and proto-products. 

- Battery scale-up: we are focusing on sodium-ion batteries, where we are designing and implementing a pre-industrial pilot production line (pouch and cylindrical formats). Additionally, we have active work lines on redox flow batteries, addressing both electrolyte and system-level challenges.

- Modules and packs: We focus on stationary applications with the complete design of modules, which are intended to be as modular and technology-agnostic as possible. Also, we are developing modular and encapsulated solutions that integrate power conversion systems (PCS), battery management systems (BMS) and other technology.

- Power electronics and Grid interface: we develop modular and configurable converters and inverters as well as distributed and decentralised controls. These solutions enable the rapid creation of hybrid battery systems that combine different battery chemistries or integrate batteries with other technologies such as hydrogen or supercapacitors. Our approach enhances the flexibility and efficiency of energy storage systems, allowing them to adapt to various grid and application demands.

Iagon is an AI-driven shared storage and compute economy that bridges decentralization with compliance. Iagon’s autonomous, innovative cloud service marketplace provides privacy, security and operational sovereignty for both enterprise & retail consumers while enabling compliant solutions at the click of a button. Pioneering the next generation of cloud services, Iagon is built on the core tenets of decentralization, giving data ownership back to the users and removing any central point of control. Through data sharding, encryption and a global network of server nodes, Iagon mitigates the security and privacy risks of traditional centralized cloud services, while eliminating surveillance and single points of failure.
With Iagon cloud services, businesses and individuals can leverage a network of resource providers to facilitate their needs, while remaining compliant with their region of operation. Complete operational sovereignty enables each user to set parameters for how and where their data is stored, with active transparent insights and monitoring available at all times. Through Iagon, consumers can store, use, test and deploy in a traditional manner, while benefiting from the advantages of a secure, decentralized and compliant network.

entityDescription:
Our mission is to empower cities and territories to reach their climate neutrality targets by providing precise evaluations of public policies on greenhouse gases. Our user-friendly tool, based on fully automated real-time Greenhouse Gas atmospheric measurements, offers a unique interface for public communication, making climate action accessible to all.
Origins.earth finds its genesis in the ambition of the City of Paris to become the first capital city in the world able to constantly measure the GHG emissions of its territory. The project, fully realised and financed by Suez in collaboration with the Laboratoire des Sciences du Climat et de l'Environnement (LSCE) - a joint CNRS-CEA unit founded by Jean Jouzel - was a success not only in scientific terms but also in the total respect of the planned time and resources.
We developed Meteo Carbone®, the world's first technological solution for real time monitoring of urban GHG emissions. This tool, combining complex spatial processing algorithms, scientific atmospheric models and high-precision CO2 measuring stations, allows cities to assess the impact of public policies, simulate proposed actions and visualize results.
The measurement systems of Origins.earth have been referenced in 2021 by the World Meteorological Organisation of UN in their protocol for all 194 member countries and in 2022 integrated into ICOS, the European measurement network Integrated Carbon Observation System (ICOS).

entityName: INSTITUTE OF COMPUTER SCIENCEOF THE AS CR V.V.I.
entityDescription: Mission The long-term mission of the Institute is to perform frontier research (a leading research activity that co-determines world trends in development and applications) in Computer Science and to transfer the respective new knowledge to society in general and to scientific community, students and application areas in particular. The institute's long-term research plans/intentions have been naturally focused on certain specific domains reflecting the strength of institute's research staff. They are in agreement with recent trends and take into account the needs of potential application fields. In its research - in the selected areas of Computer Science - the Institute focuses mainly upon the problems inspired by current and emerging computing technologies and by the needs of the discipline and of the society. The emphasis is both on identifying and harnessing of new approaches to computing (such as nature-inspired ones) and reasoning, on their creative applications and on strengthening of existing classical methods. The institute's research objectives consist of two basic and two interdisciplinary research streams. * Theoretical activities concentrate in particular on basic research in computational mathematics, computational complexity theory, computational intelligence, computational statistics, computational learning theory, computational logic and cryptography. * Interdisciplinary and application oriented research aims at non-linear modeling and prediction, environmental informatics, medical informatics, neuroinformatics and bioinformatics. Applications are sought primarily in the fields of environmental protection, meteorology, medicine and health care, biology, banking, cognitive sciences, earth sciences, economy, business, and web technologies. In all these fields the Institute strives to contribute to and to participate in the formation of the contemporary research trends. The ultimate strategic goal is the transformation of the Institute into a renowned research center of excellence in Computer Science.

entityDescription:
Non-invasive scanning of objects and structures using so-called muon tomography - a technology similar to X-ray imaging but applicable also to large-scale areas. As this technology leverages natural cosmic rays, it's also totally passive method with free and constant source of data - big data (10,000 particles/min/m²).
We develop algorithms to process raw muon data into high-resolution 2D/3D images, detecting damages, cracks, voids, density variations, and hidden structural weaknesses. This enables precise decision-making: (i) resource explorations - reducing unnecessary drilling (e.g., from 13 test drills to pinpointed locations), (ii) infrastructure monitoring -early detection of structural issues, allowing preventive action, (iii) aerospace - scanning engine cores, combustion chambers, turbine blades, exhaust nozzles, and compressors without disassembly, (iv) nuclear waste management, (v) national security, (vi) space industry.

entityDescription:
Lambda-X High Tech SRL is taking over the development and manufacturing services of Lambda-X S.A. established in 1996 and recognized as a key player in the development and manufacturing of optical systems.
Lambda-X S.A. has, over the years, built a robust technological and managerial expertise by participating in various ambitious space research programs. 
This expertise has allowed the company to expand its activities into high-tech industrial sectors where Lambda-X provides high-level optical engineering services based on a wide range of technologies.
Lambda-X’s value proposition lies in selecting the most suitable technologies for market demands. We are committed to ensuring that the proposed solution operates under the environmental conditions dictated by the client's application while optimizing the performance-to-cost ratio. 
By adhering to these best practices, Lambda-X introduced its first revolutionary instrument 15 years ago, based on a unique technique, and quickly became the global leader in the metrology of ophthalmic lenses.
Given the significant growth in both of its divisions, the Board of Directors of Lambda-X S.A. has decided in 2023 to partially split the parent company into two distinct entities:
· Lambda-X High Tech SRL, a newly established company taking over all the service, development, and manufacturing activities of optical systems for space, security, medical diagnostics, life sciences, and industrial process control from Lambda-X S.A.
· Lambda-X Ophthamics SRL, solely specialized in ophthalmic applications.
This strategic decision will enable each of the two new companies to specialize in their respective fields and strengthen themselves technically, humanly, and financially to better serve their clients in the long term.
No operational changes distinguish Lambda-X High Tech SRL from Lambda-X S.A.: they share the same technical and administrative teams, location, and infrastructure (labs and production rooms), as well as the same shareholder structure. The ISO9001 and EN9100 certifications of Lambda-X S.A. will be transferred to Lambda-X High Tech SRL. Meanwhile, the quality system, in place for over 10 years, continues to operate under the leadership of our Quality Director.

entityDescription: LuxQuanta Technologies S.L. provides cryptography solutions to implement an extra layer of security for companies and telecommunication networks. description:
Developing solutions for the Aviation and Aerospace industry since 2010.
 Established in February of 2010, QuAero is a company founded by pilots who are also qualified in engineering, computer science, human factors and other hard sciences, brought together by an EU FP6 project as aviation technical experts. QuAero was created with research and innovation as its company vision and scope. We provide research services and participate in academic studies to help in the advancement of Aviation and Aerospace technologies. Even today, research and innovation are the lifeblood and raison d’etre of QuAero. Following the initial project that brought the company together, QuAero has actively participated in numerous research and innovation projects funded by the Malta Council for Science and Technology, all of which were in collaboration with the University of Malta. We also provide safety management consulting services, training and advisory services on software products. We help our clients create manuals for AOC compliance and train their personnel as required as well as advising on the development of software products for the aviation industry. Through our crew resource management (CRM) services we understand it is essential that pilots learn as much as possible about how best to manage all the resources available to them in the cockpit including other crew-members, procedures, the machine interface and themselves, recognising where they are most vulnerable and where their strengths lie. Lastly, we supply safety software for aviation organisations as well as various other industries, coupled with back-office consultancy such as manuals and operational systems development. QuAero is a licensed reseller of major software brands such as Centrik. Coupled with our expertise, our tech prowess and in-depth knowledge of the software make us a strong ally for our clients, in terms of operational efficiency and compliance.
